nodes.description: Conventional symptomatic therapy for keratoderma. No treatment study exists for FNEPPK2. In the one isolated focal TRPV3 case with reported treatment (p.Gly568Asp), topical tretinoin, topical corticosteroid, keratolytics and oral acitretin did not help. Erlotinib has been used in severe TRPV3-related Olmsted syndrome (PMID:31895432) but not in this disease.
